item.title: Arrests made in Sunnyvale killing of young mother; child’s father charged
item.description: Sunnyvale authorities have arrested two men, including the father of the victim’s child, in the shooting death of 24-year-old Kembery Chirinos-Flores.

item.title: San Francisco man charged with attempted murder in Chinatown stabbing
item.description: A 37-year-old man has been charged with attempted murder after an unprovoked daytime stabbing in San Francisco’s Chinatown left a victim with life-threatening injuries.
